info.title: API.SH: 11st
info.description: The 11st API from API.SH: public 11st data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every filter group the 11st search page shows for a keyword, with values and product counts: categories, brands, attributes (color, memory, size...), benefits, delivery, department-store and big-mall sellers, product type, quick filters and promotions, plus price bands and the sort orders. Each value carries the `param` to send it as in /11st/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-filters

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One 11st product: name, model, catalog id, market type, sale status, final and list price, discount rate (KRW), coupon price, maximum reward points, card benefit, rating, review and question counts, likes, badges, brand (official flag), seller id, store, delivery (text, cost, courier, arrival, order cut-off), option variations (color, capacity...) with their product ids and status, images, and the site's record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer questions on a product, 10 per page, newest first: id, type (product, delivery...), answer status, question text, masked user id, date, the seller's answer, who answered and when. Private questions keep their text hidden, as on the site. The site lists the most recent pages of questions to logged-out visitors. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-questions

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

questions.question: 완전특가 20% 할인이라고 해서 구매하려했는데 천원 혜택이 전부네요? 쿠폰다운로드를 별도로 해야하나요?
questions.answer:
+ 안녕하세요. 발리안트입니다. +
이벤트 적용 및 결제 관련 사항에 대해 안내드립니다.
모든 결제는 판매처가 아닌 *쇼핑몰 시스템을 통해 진행*되므로, 저희 쪽에서는 고객님의 개인 계정 정보, 적용 가능한 쿠폰이나 카드사 행사 일정, 상세 결제 …

questions.question: 예약판매 종료된건가요?
questions.answer:
+ 안녕하세요 발리안트입니다. +
저희 제품에 관심을 가져주시고 사전예약을 기다려 주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다.
문의하신 아이폰 17 프로 실버 모델은 높은 수요로 인해 많은 분이 찾아주고 계시나, 안타깝게도 현재 준비된 물량이 모두 소진되어 조기…

get.description:
A product's reviews, 20 per page: id, rating, text, purchased option, attribute ratings (performance, durability...), reviewer nickname as shown, date, photo links, video and seller-reply flags, with the total count. Recommended or newest first; filter by one star rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-reviews

get.description:
Search 11st (11번가, Korean marketplace) with the search page's sorts and filters: price range, brand, category, attributes (color, memory, size...), benefits and free delivery, department-store and big-mall sellers, overseas direct purchase, quick filters, include and exclude words. Each product: id, name, link, final and list price, discount rate and label (KRW), rating and scale, review count, units sold, brand, official-store flag, seller badge, delivery and arrival text, sold-out flag, 11st and 30-day lowest-price flags, payment benefits, maximum-discount price, image and the site's original record in `raw`. Page 1 also returns the featured sections (online lowest price, brand picks) and sponsored products, plus related keywords. Get filter values from /11st/v1/filters. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-search

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand code(s) from /11st/v1/filters (e.g. 14635 for Apple), comma-separated.

parameters.name: benefits
parameters.description: Benefit or delivery code(s) from /11st/v1/filters (e.g. FREE_DLV).

parameters.name: sellers
parameters.description: Seller number(s) from the department-store / big-mall filter.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: GLOBAL_DIRECT (overseas direct purchase only) or GLOBAL_DIRECT_EXCEPT.

parameters.name: quick
parameters.description: Quick filter code(s) from /11st/v1/filters (e.g. FREE_DLV_NEW, SHOCKING_DEAL).

parameters.name: service_group
parameters.description: Delivery service group code (01, 02 for fast shipping).

parameters.name: include_keyword
parameters.description: Extra word the results must contain.

parameters.name: exclude_keyword
parameters.description: Word the results must not contain.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
11st's live top search keywords: rank, keyword, rank change, the site's note and a search link, with the update time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/11st-trending

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
